_comment: The .dmg window layout. tools/make_dmg_background.py draws the background from it and packaging/dmg/settings.py places the icons with it, so the two always agree. Units are Finder points; the @2x background is twice the size.

subtitle.text: Drag termSwitch to your Applications folder to install it.

footer.text: Then eject this disk and open termSwitch from Applications.
